classic-cartoon.label: Classic cartoon
classic-cartoon.instruction: Redraw <Picture 1> as a bright 2D holiday cartoon in a hand-drawn animated-series style: bold clean outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, simple soft shading, and a cheerful festive mood. Keep the same composition, subjects, poses, and main colors so it is clearly the same scene.

claymation.label: Claymation
claymation.instruction: Turn <Picture 1> into a still from a stop-motion claymation holiday special: everything sculpted from smooth modeling clay and felt, with visible fingerprints, rounded chunky shapes, and warm miniature-set lighting with a shallow depth of field. Keep the same composition, subjects, and main colors.

storybook.label: Storybook
storybook.instruction: Repaint <Picture 1> as a page from a cozy vintage children's picture book: loose watercolor washes, fine ink linework, soft paper texture, and gentle warm light. Keep the same composition, subjects, and main colors so it is clearly the same scene.

retro-card.label: Retro card
retro-card.instruction: Redraw <Picture 1> as a 1950s mid-century holiday greeting card illustration: simplified geometric shapes, a limited palette of red, teal, cream, and gold, slight print misregistration, and a subtle halftone paper texture. Keep the same composition and subjects.

anime.label: Cozy anime
anime.instruction: Repaint <Picture 1> as a frame from a cozy hand-painted anime film: soft painterly backgrounds, clean expressive linework, glowing warm highlights, and a calm wintry atmosphere. Keep the same composition, subjects, and main colors.

pixel-art.label: Pixel art
pixel-art.instruction: Convert <Picture 1> into detailed 16-bit pixel art like a retro holiday video game scene: crisp square pixels, a limited festive palette, dithered shading, and no blur or anti-aliasing. Keep the same composition, subjects, and main colors.
